responsibility: Provides the OpenBSD/ELF operating-system layer for the PA port. It defines OpenBSD preprocessor builtins, ELF/GAS assembly conventions, PA-specific function and external-libcall emission, common/local BSS output hooks, ABI type definitions for size and wide-character types, and OpenBSD linker/start/end-file specs, so PA code generation and driver behavior match OpenBSD’s runtime and assembler expectations.
